propositions: _apply_authorship returns silently when signing_key is configured but author_id is unresolvable and require_authenticated is off, hiding unsigned writes from logs
fsck authorship tally is aggregated store-wide without per-env breakdown, making a single env with 0% signed rate invisible behind other envs' healthy volume

fsck must report as a counted issue any env_id that has no signed events or authors everything Unknown, gated to envs that wrote at or after the store's earliest signed event, excluding dormant pre-signing envs
_apply_authorship must emit a logger.warning when signing is skipped due to missing author_id or signing_key, naming the event uuid and reason, while remaining best-effort (no write failure)
held-out tests must verify that active 0%-signed envs are counted by fsck and that dormant pre-signing envs are not reported
held-out tests must verify that the seam's skip-path logs at WARNING and still writes the event unsigned
